main.description: Assert a first-class maritime CHOKEPOINT into the kotoba Datom log (:chokepoint/*). The `keyword` is the SHARED join key carried by :flow/via, watari :lane/chokepoint, and watatsuna :station/chokepoint — promoting it from a bare keyword to a geographic node lets the three maps plot the same hotspot. Coordinates are coarse corridor centroids (a corridor, not a target point; G1/G2 — resilience map, never interdiction).

keyword.description: shared chokepoint keyword (= :flow/via member = watari :lane/chokepoint = watatsuna :station/chokepoint)

lat.description: coarse corridor centroid latitude (not a target point; G2)

txCid.description: kotoba transaction CID (content-addressed Datom log; ADR-2605312345)
